title: WEDM Print-to-Program Production Readiness — Complete Gap Remediation
philosophy: Close ALL identified gaps to deliver accurate, safe, optimal, and cost-efficient WEDM Print-to-Program with full AI orchestration. 5-agent scrutiny identified 27 gaps across accuracy, safety, optimization, cost, and orchestration domains. This milestone addresses all P0/P1 gaps.

rollback_strategy.on_test_failure: Revert engine file, fix issue, re-run tests
rollback_strategy.on_safety_violation: Block merge, escalate to safety review, add missing guard
rollback_strategy.on_build_failure: Check tsc errors, fix imports, verify no circular deps

phases.title: Safety-Critical Foundation
phases.rationale: Wire break prevention and accuracy foundation. Must complete before any production use.

phases.title: Accuracy + Orchestration Core
phases.rationale: Physics accuracy and one-click workflow. Enables reliable automated operation.

phases.title: Optimization Layer
phases.rationale: Cycle time optimization. Reduces job cost through intelligent parameter selection.

phases.title: Cost + Learning + Integration
phases.rationale: Quote accuracy, continuous learning, and frontend integration fixes.

U-PROD-01.title: WEDMCurrentDensityGuardEngine
U-PROD-01.description: Runtime validation of current density against wire cross-section. Formula: J = I / (π × (d/2)²) must be ≤ max_current_density_A_mm2 from wire specs. Block discharge if exceeded.
U-PROD-01.physics: J_max varies by wire: brass 15-20 A/mm², coated 25-30 A/mm², moly 35-40 A/mm²
U-PROD-01.rollback: If guard too restrictive, adjust thresholds from wire specs. If too permissive, add safety margin.
U-PROD-01.indexing: Export from src/engines/index.ts, add to WEDMSafetyEnvelopeEngine integration
U-PROD-01.exit_criteria: Engine validates current density. Blocks unsafe parameters. 10+ tests passing.
U-PROD-01.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-02.title: WEDMPulseLimitEngine
U-PROD-02.description: On-time/off-time limits per wire diameter and material. Ton_max prevents thermal overload. Toff_min ensures debris flushing. Tables from Mitsubishi/Sodick tech data.
U-PROD-02.physics: Ton_max = f(wire_d, material_thermal_diffusivity). Typical: 0.25mm brass Ton_max = 8μs
U-PROD-02.rollback: If limits conflict with existing tech tables, prioritize conservative values. Validate against Mitsubishi specs.
U-PROD-02.indexing: Export from src/engines/index.ts, integrate with EDMMultiPassStrategyEngine
U-PROD-02.exit_criteria: Engine enforces pulse timing limits. Integration with EDMMultiPassStrategyEngine.
U-PROD-02.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-03.title: WEDMPowerDensityGuardEngine
U-PROD-03.description: Instantaneous power density validation. P_density = V × I / wire_surface_area. Guard against thermal overload causing mid-cut wire failure.
U-PROD-03.physics: P_max = wire_thermal_capacity × cooling_factor. Typical limit: 50-100 W/mm²
U-PROD-03.rollback: If combined with current density creates over-restriction, verify against published wire failure data.
U-PROD-03.exit_criteria: Engine validates power density. Integrates with safety envelope.
U-PROD-03.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-04.title: WEDMKerfWidthEngine
U-PROD-04.description: Explicit kerf width prediction: kerf = wire_d + 2×spark_gap. Spark gap from material/power settings. Wire tension correction for corners.
U-PROD-04.physics: spark_gap = k × (I_p^α × t_on^β)^0.5, k from dielectric properties
U-PROD-04.exit_criteria: Kerf prediction within ±5% of published data. 15+ validation tests.
U-PROD-04.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-05.title: WEDMWireDeflectionEngine
U-PROD-05.description: Wire deflection model using beam theory: δ = F×L³/(3×E×I). Cutting force from spark pressure. Dynamic tension compensation for taper cuts.
U-PROD-05.physics: δ = (P_spark × kerf × thickness) × L³ / (3 × E_wire × π×d⁴/64)
U-PROD-05.exit_criteria: Deflection model validated against Kunieda 2005 data. Taper compensation working.
U-PROD-05.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-06.title: WEDMThinWireDerateEngine
U-PROD-06.description: Automatic parameter derating for thin wires (≤0.15mm). Reduce current, power, feed rate proportionally. Critical for 0.05mm tungsten and 0.10mm moly.
U-PROD-06.physics: derate_factor = (d/0.25)^n where n=1.5-2.0 based on wire material
U-PROD-06.exit_criteria: Thin wire parameters auto-derated. No wire breaks in test scenarios.
U-PROD-06.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine created, tests passing, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-07.title: WEDMDXFClosureValidatorEngine
U-PROD-07.description: Validate DXF profiles are closed contours. Detect gaps, overlaps, and near-misses. Report closure tolerance and suggest fixes.
U-PROD-07.exit_criteria: Detects open contours with 0.001mm tolerance. Suggests closure points.
U-PROD-07.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine + tests created, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-08.title: WEDMDielectricCorrectionEngine
U-PROD-08.description: Dielectric-specific correction factors for spark gap. DI water vs oil affects gap by 10-15%. Integrate with kerf width and offset calculations.
U-PROD-08.exit_criteria: Dielectric correction integrated. Dimensional accuracy improved 10%.
U-PROD-08.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine + tests created, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-09.title: OneClickWEDMGeneratorEngine
U-PROD-09.description: Single entry point: drop DXF → get G-code. Auto-chains all 30 pipeline stages with sensible defaults. Material/machine auto-detection from filename/metadata.
U-PROD-09.rollback: If stage fails, checkpoint state and allow resume. Return partial result with failure context.
U-PROD-09.indexing: Export from src/engines/index.ts, wire to /api/edm/one-click route
U-PROD-09.exit_criteria: DXF to G-code in single call. <5s for simple profiles. All defaults validated.
U-PROD-09.verified: 2026-04-18: Engine + tests created, exported from index.ts

U-PROD-10.title: WEDMProgressTrackerEngine

U-PROD-10.exit_criteria: Progress events emitted. Frontend can display stage/ETA. Accuracy within 20%.

U-PROD-13.title: WEDMStartPointOptimizationEngine
U-PROD-13.description: Intelligent start point selection to minimize witness marks. Consider surface criticality, approach angle, and material ejection path.
U-PROD-13.exit_criteria: Start points avoid critical surfaces. Selection algorithm documented.

U-PROD-14.title: WEDMMultiProfileBatchEngine
U-PROD-14.description: TSP-style optimization for multi-profile jobs. Minimize total rapid travel + threading events. Consider thermal equilibrium across profiles.
U-PROD-14.physics: TSP with threading penalty: cost = distance + k×thread_count
U-PROD-14.exit_criteria: Batch optimization reduces total time by ≥15% vs naive ordering.

U-PROD-15.title: WEDMWireThreadingMinEngine
U-PROD-15.description: Minimize wire threading events (30-120s each). Continuous cut path planning. Threading vs wire life tradeoff optimization.
U-PROD-15.exit_criteria: Threading events reduced by 30% vs baseline. Wire life not compromised.

U-PROD-16.title: WEDMCornerPhysicsEngine
U-PROD-16.description: Physics-based corner slowdown. Velocity profile from corner angle, material, Ra target. Prevent overcut at sharp corners.
U-PROD-16.exit_criteria: Corner accuracy improved. No overcut on sharp corners (<30°).

U-PROD-17.title: WEDMAdaptivePassEngine

U-PROD-17.exit_criteria: Adaptive pass logic working. 20% pass reduction on over-specified jobs.
